summary: Phase 4: Simplify feedback options - remove 'later', add 'too_hard', adjust weights

budget_impact.rationale: UI and feedback logic changes only; no new model calls introduced.
budget_impact.before: Three feedback options: useful (save), irrelevant, later (neutral)
budget_impact.after: Three feedback options: useful (save), irrelevant, too_hard. Removed 'later' which users didn't use effectively.

checks.evidence: 178 non-HTTP tests passed; 18 HTTP errors due to sandbox

open_risks: Users with existing 'later' feedback will see it as 'too_hard' in stats (migration not needed, just display mapping)
Too_hard papers may reappear after decay - this is intentional per design
